ceremony.choreography: docs/26-paired-ceremonies.md section 3: list, grant, relabel and revoke by an admin manager, and the manager's key swap; negatives for a non-admin, an unknown subject, a repeated grant, a replay, a tampered or unsigned document, a wrong recipient and a stale clock

scenarios.title: the member's wallet, an admin manager of the agent, lists the access list, grants a second subject, relabels it and revokes it: the agent's list shows the row after the grant and the new label, and omits it after the revoke
spec: TF specs/acl/grant/0.3/spec.md (the granting authority adds the subject; the response echoes the entry)
TF specs/acl/update/0.3/spec.md (label replaced on an existing entry)
TF specs/acl/revoke/0.3/spec.md (a removal; the subject loses its authority at its next decision)
TF specs/acl/list/0.4/spec.md (read-only enumeration)
